data.description:
## Context

`tests/unit/test_network_fetch_stall_abort_851e.py::test_init_fetch_dribbling_remote_is_not_aborted` failed during a 40-minute full suite because Git observed less than 1000 bytes/sec for the 2-second test window. The identical test passed immediately afterward with no code or environment changes. The fixture server targets 4000 bytes/sec, so scheduler starvation can create a false stall classification.

## Plan

Reproduce under controlled CPU/thread contention, compare all three dribbling cases in the file, and make the fixture discriminate transport stalls without relying on a 2-second scheduler-sensitive window. Preserve the production low-speed mechanism and its zero-byte stall coverage.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A deterministic stress reproduction demonstrates the pre-fix false stall.
- [ ] The dribbling cases remain green under that stress without weakening zero-byte stall assertions.
- [ ] Production stall thresholds and behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

Full suite: 11,881 passed and this test failed with `Operation too slow. Less than 1000 bytes/sec transferred the last 2 seconds`. Isolated unchanged rerun passed.
data.title: Dribbling git-fetch test flakes under full-suite scheduler load
